title: A failed data fetch shows the error toast which fades after 5 seconds
refs: SV-8582 (SBC spec v20 2026-08-17 §7 User Feedback Summary — the data-fetch error toast; CROSS-CUTTING: the SBC spec carries no error-state story of its own so the epic key is used deliberately)
preconds:
1. You can interrupt the network (browser dev tools offline mode).
2. To force the failure this test needs, use the browser's own developer tools: press F12, open the "Network" tab, and switch the throttling dropdown (it normally reads "No throttling") to "Offline" to cut the connection, or to "Slow 3G" to slow it down. There is nothing to install. Set it back to "No throttling" when you finish..
steps:
1. Go offline, then open the report (or change a filter to force a re-fetch).
2. Read the toast and time how long it stays.
expected:
1. An error toast is shown: "An error occurred while fetching the report data."
2. The toast auto-fades after 5 seconds.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (§7 User Feedback Summary), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
